diagnosis: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ (Bowen disease)
legend: High-power view of the dermatopathology of the case of Bowen disease shown in <<37241>> and <<37242>>, with acanthosis of the epidermis, hyperkeratosis and parakeratosis, full-thickness dysplasia, and a lymphocytic infiltrate.

Full-thickness atypia of epidermis is seen. Atypical cells involve / encroach upon adnexal epithelium (unlike in bowenoid actinic keratosis). Increased mitotic figures with atypical forms are observed, as well as hyperkeratosis with confluent parakeratosis.
